statement: OCRmyPDF already handles conservative PDF OCR orchestration tasks such as rotation, deskew and oversampling.
actakit_implication: Reuse it rather than reimplementing PDF-to-image/OCR grafting.

statement: Some preprocessing/force modes rasterize pages or can remove desirable visual content.
actakit_implication: Original Representation is immutable; preprocessing/OCR always produces derivatives with explicit parameters.

statement: OCRmyPDF 17 deliberately supports replaceable OCR engines and non-OCR preprocessing.
actakit_implication: It can serve as D2 orchestration while ActaKit retains its own higher-level escalation policy.

statement: A reliable PDF OCR stack includes rasterizer/text-layer/system dependencies beyond the OCR engine itself.
actakit_implication: Treat deployment capability detection as part of processor availability.
